message.skyabyss.ember.surface.asleep: The earth smells hot. Somewhere, a mountain is breathing in its sleep...
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.mouth_hin: While it breathes in, walk into the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.spat_out: The titan's breath spat you out. Not yet.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.giv: A warm pebble sits in your pocket, fired clay of the ash folk. Hold it, and a far heat moves into your hand.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.not: Grip it while standing on solid land.
The stone does not answer. Try again around sunset.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.no_: There is no flat ground here for a mountain to lie down on.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.ask: The stone grows hot. Tonight, the mountain sleeps beside you.
The warm stone leans toward %s. It will sleep there tonight.
message.skyabyss.ember.surface.stone.too: Held, the warmer hand points toward the Ember Titan
Grip it on land around sunset to ask it to sleep nearby
commands.skyabyss.ember.missing: The ember titan is not loaded
commands.skyabyss.ember.no_spot: No sleeping place nearby (flat land 16 blocks in front of the mouth)

message.skyabyss.ember.back.stone_ready: Deep in the kindle stone, a fire stirs.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.east_silent: The kindle stone is silent. The smith still stands at the forge.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.south_silent: The kindle stone is silent. The hearth fire is still thin.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.shortcut_ope: The floor by the stone begins to glow like embers.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.all_rung: Three stones have rung. The fire in the great forge begins to waver.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.gate_open: The forge fire died. The cooled hearth floor opens downward.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.shortcut: The ember floor carried you back to the hall.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.trials_renew: The ember titan's heart beats again, a beat returning from far beneath your feet. The fires inside the body have rekindled.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.group_change: Your companions changed, and so did the fires. You were led back to the hall's campfire.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.peaceful: The titan does not wake. The throat is closed.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.gave_up: The cold fire pushed you back onto the tongue.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.campfire_hin: The blue fire is the ash folk's cold fire. Sneak and touch it to return to the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.heat.scorching: You are starting to scorch. Cool down on an ash pool
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.mouth: The tongue is hot. Deep in the throat, red light swells with each breath.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.throat: Heat builds near lava and fades on ash. Before you scorch, stand on a grey ash pool.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.hub: Under the ribs stands the great forge of the ash folk. Its fire has never gone out.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.ash: Standing on a grey ash pool draws the heat out of you.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.west: The ash road. Scatter ash and the lava lake cools into crust.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.east: The forge hall. Strike when the colour is right.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.south: The hearth keepers. Do not let the fire die. The bursts of heat burn foes too.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.well: The forge heat rises up the shaft. You warm as you climb.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.crater: From the crater you see the ash plain and the night sky. Far below, the forge still burns.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.back: The seams of the back scales glow like embers.
message.skyabyss.ember.whisper.heart: Beyond the wall, something beats slowly.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.arrived: It is hot. The ash underfoot is warm, like breath.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.leaving: Down the ash steps, the night air was cold.
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.urn_gi: You take an ash urn. It can scatter ash on the lava you face
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.urn_re: The ash urn is full again
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.urn_em: The ash urn is empty. Refill it at an island's ash pool
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.no_lav: No lava within reach to scatter on
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.urn_re: The urn went back to its stand
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.engulf: The lava swallowed you. You are back on the last island
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.west.far_sh: You reached the far shore. The ember stone can ring
item.skyabyss.ash_urn.desc2: Refills at an island's ash pool (gray wool). Returns to its stand when you leave the lake
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.trough: Touch the trough holding a hot fire key
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.doused: Ash is thrown on the forge
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.no_blo: The forge mouth is empty. Wait for a new bloom
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.read_0: The bloom is black, still cold
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.read_4: The bloom is white. Too hot
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.invent: Your inventory is full; you cannot take the key
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.bloom_: The white-hot bloom split. Wait for a new one
The bloom split. Wait for a new one
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.key_fo: The fire key is forged. To the trough before it cools
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.key_qu: The key is quenched. To the smith's door
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.key_cr: The key cooled and cracked. Forge again from a bloom
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.door_k: The door's pattern lights up, inward
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.door_o: The door is open. Something stirs inside
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.door_h: It needs a quenched fire key
item.skyabyss.fire_key_hot.desc: Cracks after 10 seconds. Hurry to the quench trough
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.south.coal_: Live coal fades when you leave the valley
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.south.heart: Right-click the hearth holding a live coal
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.south.douse: Ash is thrown on the hearth
message.skyabyss.ember.trial.south.burni: The hearth blazes. The southern ember stone can ring
item.skyabyss.live_coal.desc: A still-red coal. Right-click the hearth for +8 fire. Holding it builds heat
message.skyabyss.ember.mob.command.ignit: Broke the shells of %s Ash Thralls
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.begin: Deep in the forge, a hunched shape picks up its hammer
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.hint_back: After it exhales, the bellows on its back glow white. Strike from behind. Cool down at the ash pools and troughs
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.asleep: The smith does not stir now
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.breath: The bellows swell. Hot wind is coming
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.quench: The smith walks to a trough. Steam rises
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.rage: The smith throws off its apron. The furnace door opens
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.after: The hammer fell to the floor. The tongs will not let go of the bloom
message.skyabyss.ember.smith.east_stone_: The ember stone at the back can ring now
subtitles.skyabyss.ember_heart_beat: A heart beats at the bottom of the furnace
subtitles.skyabyss.ember_heart_roar: The furnace roars and the shell cracks
subtitles.skyabyss.ember_heart_death: The heart stops and the shell turns to ash
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.begin: The entrance is sealed. At the bottom of the embers, the heart begins to burn
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.asleep: The heart sleeps deeply (it will not wake on Peaceful)
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.descend: You reach the bottom of the spiral: the antechamber of the embers. Heat and a beat come through the far door.
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.exit_hint: When the fight is over, the pillar of light on the platform carries you back to the furnace hall
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.pillar: The pillar of light carried you back to the furnace hall
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.defeated: The heart of the embers has stopped. Every light at the bottom has gone out, and ash is falling
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.go: You are in the antechamber of the embers (the heart room is beyond the far door)
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.choice_late: Your first-clear gift (one exclusive legend) can be chosen with /titanmemory ember once the items exist
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.reward: What the heart of the embers left behind has reached your hands
message.skyabyss.ember.heart.frozen: You are freezing. Step into the embers to warm up
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_titan.title: The One That Swims the Earth
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_titan.body:
The hill beyond the fields had come a little closer overnight. In the morning, only the soil between the hill and the fields was warm, in a long band.

That night the hill breathed smoke, and slept.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_ruins.title: The Forge of the Ash Folk
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_ruins.body:
Deep in the chest stood a great forge. Bellows, anvil, quenching trough: all within reach, as if someone had used them a moment ago.

Here and there, the ash on the floor was heaped as high as a person.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.forge_ledger.body:
Each day, a count of what was fed to the forge. Toward the end the numbers grow. Year by year, it seems, the fire needed more to keep it alive.

The last line is not a number. It says only: "down."
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ash_smith.title: The Ash Smith
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ash_smith.body:
The hammer fell to the floor, but the tongs never let go of the bloom. It was still red.

As if it were waiting for the last blow it was meant to receive.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_stilled.bod:
The ember heart stopped. One by one the veins went dark, and the room grew suddenly cold. Only the ash kept falling.

Where did this fire come from, and where has it gone?
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_ember: It stood on the titan's tongue, just before the throat. It reads like a welcome, or like an order.
It stood beside the great forge in the hall. Looking into the forge's floor, the red glow goes on far below.
It stood on the far shore of the Ash Path. Even as you read, the cooled crust underfoot creaked.
It was carved above the quenching trough in the Smith's Hall. One of the four is in your hands now.
It was carved into the hearthstone at the bottom of the rift. Each time the fire thins, the ground seems to sink a little.
It was on the wall of the room before the Ember Depths. This one alone has been carved over, again and again.
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ember_back: Found on the ember titan's back. Columns of numbers in sooty ink
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.tong: You stand on the tongue. From deep in the throat, a breath like a bellows comes and goes
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.thro: The gauge at the top right is your heat. It rises near lava and falls in ash heaps. While you are flushed, ash shells crack easily
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.hub: Ring the three kindle stones, west, east and south, and the central forge will cool and its floor will open
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.west: Scatter ash from the urn on the lava to make a crust road. The crust soon crumbles. Ash heaps on the islands refill the urn
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.east: Read the forge's color. Strike when it matches the mark. Then quench it before it cools and cracks
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.sout: Do not let the hearth die. Feed it live coals, and lure enemies over the vents
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.well: The forge's heat escapes up the shaft. If you climb, climb in one breath
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.hear: From under the grate rise an ember glow and a beat that comes a little late
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.slee: The soil smells hot. Somewhere, a mountain is breathing in its sleep...
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.brea: While it breathes in, into the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.spat: The titan's breath spat you out. It is too soon
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.ston: Somehow, there is a warm stone in your pocket
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.aske: You grip the stone. Tonight it will sleep near here
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.ask_: The stone stays cool. Someone else has called it tonight
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.stone_r: A kindle stone rang. One of the hall's fires sank
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.all_sto: All three kindle stones rang. The forge cools, and the grate in its floor opens
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.doused: Ash was thrown into the forge
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.quenche: The key hissed, and set hard
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.door: Fire runs along the door's pattern
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.south.low: The fire has grown small again
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.south.full: The hearth fire rises all the way to the rift above
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.smith.wake: Before the forge, a great ash-covered shape picks up its hammer
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.smith.fallen: The smith falls to its knees. The tongs still grip the bloom
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.heart.chill: The veins go dark. The room is growing cold
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.heart.fragme: The fourth fragment. In your hand, it searches for the others
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.finale.dawn: Far beneath your feet, something turned over in its sleep
item.skyabyss.ember_armor.desc: Two pieces harden the shell; four let heat settle into you. On the ember titan's back heat builds slowly, and your blows land harder while flushed. Touching fire fills you with strength
item.skyabyss.ember_war_axe.desc: Leaves what it strikes smoldering. Bites deeper into anything burning or smoldering
item.skyabyss.ember_mantle.desc: While worn as a trinket, heat builds slowly and fire and lava hurt less (it does not stop fire itself)
item.skyabyss.kindling_charm.desc: When used, it draws the heat out of your body and breathes it onto nearby foes (rests 50 seconds after use)
item.skyabyss.smith_hammer.desc: A two-handed sledge. Every third blow sends a crack through the floor that erupts a moment later
item.skyabyss.thrall_poker.desc: Long reach. Each blow heaps ash on the foe; when it sets, their legs and guard go dull
item.skyabyss.ember_lantern.desc: While worn as a trinket, it once holds you up against a fatal blow and burns what is near (sleeps 600 seconds after)
item.skyabyss.ember_horn.desc: A warm drink with embers melted into it. On the ember titan's back it slows your heat; elsewhere it wards off fire for a while
item.skyabyss.ember_shard.desc: A still-warm flake of the ember titan's shell. Used to temper ember gear
item.skyabyss.ember_core.desc: An ember from the ember heart that will not go out. One day it will become part of a relic
item.skyabyss.spark_dust.desc: Powder shed from an ember moth's wings. Works in fireworks in place of gunpowder
item.skyabyss.cinder_husk.desc: A plate from a cinder roller's back. Even cold, its seams glow faintly red
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_no_clear.emb: Defeat the ember heart to choose
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_all_owned.em: You already own every ember legendary
tooltip.skyabyss.ember.horn_drunk: Warmth spreads slowly from your core. Heat will build more slowly for a while
__ember.H: 四章の伝承 (lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_hearth、ember_prev_page。生成元 tools/gen_ch4_content.py)
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_hearth.titl: A Hearth of the Ash People
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_hearth.body:
A small hearth of fired stone is set into the ground. The ash had been raked together in the shape of a hand.

Its mouth always faces the hill. They kept it lit not so the fire would live, but so the hill would not wake.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_prev_page.b:
A torn page. A short note remains in a hand that looks familiar.

"On days when the ground is warm, I do not look at the hill. I feel it would meet my eyes."

... This handwriting resembles your own.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.quiet_west: Tonight the western ash road is quiet. No ember moths, no cinder rollers.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.quiet_east: Tonight the eastern forge is quiet. No ash douser comes, and the iron colors come in the gentlest order. The smith waits beyond the furnace.
message.skyabyss.ember.back.quiet_south: Tonight the southern hearth is quiet. The fire fades slowly and few ash carriers come. No moths, no rollers.
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.trial_q: The fire of the %s is quiet tonight

gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.west.stone: Touch the ember stone on the far shore
gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.west.done: The west stone has rung. The glowing floor returns you to the hall
gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.bellows: Step on a bellows pedal to heat the furnace. Press, then run to the anvil
gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.strike.red: While the bloom glows RED, right-click the hammer stand on the anvil (strike %3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.strike.oran: While the bloom glows ORANGE, right-click the hammer stand on the anvil (strike %3$s / %4$s)
gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.strike.yell: While the bloom glows YELLOW, right-click the hammer stand on the anvil (strike %3$s / %4$s)

gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.door: Right-click the smith's door with the quenched key

gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.east.done: The east stone has rung. The glowing floor returns you to the hall

gui.skyabyss.ember_goal.south.stone: The hearth blazes. Touch the ember stone at the back

message.skyabyss.ember_cache_bay_east: You took the ridge shrine's gift
